Maria L: AM async — quick status: onboarded tinyq-v2 to staging and ran gated evals. Observed a regression on translation promptset (EM drop). Blocker: CI is flaking on kv-cache regen which blocks the full rerun. PR #482 opened for the prompt tweak but needs review.
Samir K: looking now. can you paste the failing test log and the eval link? I’ll try to repro locally.
Devon T: failing unit trace below — kv cache invalidation throws on warmup: 
```
E 14:02:45 kube: kvcache: mismatch len: expected 8192 got 0
Trace: RuntimeError: cache regen failed at warmup
    at models/cache.js:112:21
```
AJ: noted — if the prompt tweak lands we should also add the new promptset id to the gating harness (translation_v2). Otherwise the rollout won't gate correctly.
Riley: I can run a dedicated-pool smoke eval in ~15m. ping me when you re-run so I can compare staging vs dedicated metrics.
EvalBot: auto-eval summary: translation_promptset (translation_v2) delta = -3.8% EM, top-mode failures flagged (hallucinated dates/entities). Full report: https://internal-evals/redwood/2249801234
ops-bot: staging deploy: tinyq-v2 @ commit 9f3bcd deployed to staging (region: us-west-2).
Maria L: thanks — Samir if you can reproduce, I’ll try skipping kv warmup locally and re-run evals. If that improves, we can patch the warmup path and retest. PR #482 is ready for review (description + perf numbers attached).
Samir K: will have a look in the next hour. if I run into CI flakes i'll respin the job and attach logs here.
Devon T: +1 on skipping warmup for a quick check, also adding a short smoke in the CI to validate kv size after regen.
AJ: FYI I pushed a tiny gating config change to my fork to include translation_v2 — will open a PR if we decide to gate on it.
Riley: started dedicated-pool run, ETA ~12m. I'll paste a short diff once done.
Maria L: great. blocker action items: (1) Samir reproduce CI flake, (2) try kv warmup skip, (3) review PR #482, (4) Riley compare dedicated vs staging. ping here with short notes; thumbs or quick status updates only. :thumbsup:
